# Create Real Matrix From Eigenvalues

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Construct the real companion matrix for roots 2 and 3. Its characteristic polynomial is t squared minus 5t plus 6. The last row is \[-6,5\].

## What this example demonstrates

Construct the real companion matrix for roots 2 and 3. Its characteristic polynomial is t squared minus 5t plus 6. The last row is \[-6,5\].
